source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
An Asuryani army gets a fresh pool at round start (Incursion 2, Strike Force 4, Onslaught 6). Discard what remains at round end. Spend one token when the relevant trigger occurs, using a unit that has Battle Focus. Each unit gets one manoeuvre per phase. Each manoeuvre also has a once-per-phase limit unless it grants an exception.

Swift as the Wind • Pick when choosing the unit for a Normal move, Advance or Fall Back. Its models gain +2″ Move for that phase. Other eligible units may use this option in the same phase.
Flitting Shadows • Pick at movement selection (Normal move, Advance or Fall Back), battlefield setup or charge declaration. The unit is protected from enemy Fire Overwatch for the rest of that turn.
Star Engines • Pick a Vehicle as it is chosen to Advance. Its ranged weapons gain Assault for the rest of that turn.
Opportunity Seized • After an enemy finishes Falling Back, pick an eligible non-Titanic unit that began the phase in Engagement Range with that foe. It may make a Normal move, capped at D6+1″.
Fade Back • After an enemy shoots in its Shooting phase, pick an eligible non-Titanic unit hit by at least one of its attacks. It may make a Normal move, capped at D6+1″.
Sudden Strike • Pick when choosing the unit to fight. For that phase, its models may travel up to 6″ per Pile-in or Consolidation instead of 3″.

Swift as the Wind.trigger: unit selected for Normal move, Advance or Fall Back

Flitting Shadows.trigger: movement selection (Normal move, Advance or Fall Back), battlefield setup or charge declaration
Flitting Shadows.protection: enemy Fire Overwatch cannot shoot at this unit

Opportunity Seized.trigger: enemy finishes a Fall Back move
Opportunity Seized.eligibleUnit: non-Titanic, started phase within Engagement Range with that foe

Fade Back.trigger: just after enemy shoots in opposing Shooting phase
Fade Back.eligibleUnit: non-Titanic and hit at least once by those attacks
